name: Dual Opportunist (Combat)
body:
You move both of your weapons as one when catching an opponent off guard.

Prerequisite(s): Two-Weapon Fighting, base attack bonus +3.

Benefit(s): When wielding two weapons, when an opponent provokes an attack of opportunity from you may attack once with each weapon at your highest base attack bonus, applying all penalties for two weapon fighting as normal. Both of these attacks count as attacks of opportunity. This feat grants you an additional attack of opportunity per round which does not stack with additional attacks of opportunity granted by other feats that provide additional attacks of opportunity.

Special: This feat counts as Combat Reflexes for the purpose of meeting feat prerequisites.
